canonical_example.translation: Thanks to his great ear, he's discovered many successful artists.

canonical_example.text: Nunca metas algo afilado en el oído.
canonical_example.translation: Never stick something sharp in your ear.

canonical_example.text: Mi oído se dañó cuando un altavoz al frente mío falló.
canonical_example.translation: My hearing was damaged when a speaker in front of me malfunctioned.

canonical_example.text: Si vas afuera, verás unos alces en la distancia.
canonical_example.translation: If you go outside, you'll see some moose in the distance.

canonical_example.text: Quiero ir afuera. El tiempo hoy está buenísimo.
canonical_example.translation: I want to go out. The weather is great today.

canonical_example.text: No me gusta dormir afuera. Siempre me pican los mosquitos.
canonical_example.translation: I don't like to sleep outdoors. I always get bitten by mosquitos.

canonical_example.text: Perdón, no te puedo ayudar con la mudanza. Ando afuera.
canonical_example.translation: Sorry, I can't help you with the move. I'm out of town.

canonical_example.text: Muchas personas viven justo en las afueras de la ciudad.
canonical_example.translation: Many people live just on the outskirts of the city.

canonical_example.text: Falta aforar el instrumento para obtener la medida adecuada.
canonical_example.translation: Now we need to gauge the instrument to get the correct measure.

canonical_example.text: Vienen a aforar la mercancía para realizar el pago correspondiente.
canonical_example.translation: They're here to value the merchandise in order to make the corresponding payment.

canonical_example.text: Me parece que aforaron las existencias en un valor menor al real.
canonical_example.translation: I think that they appraised the stock in a lower value than the real one.

canonical_example.text: El veterinario me recomendó dar de comer a los animales otro tipo de pienso.
canonical_example.translation: The vet recommended that I should give the animals a different kind of fodder.

canonical_example.text: Los cerdos ibéricos de primera comen bellotas y hierba en vez de pienso.
canonical_example.translation: First-class Iberian pigs eat acorns and grass instead of feed.

canonical_example.text: Toby debe comer pienso especial porque lo esterilizamos hace poco.
canonical_example.translation: Toby needs to eat special dry kibble because we had him neutered recently.

canonical_example.text: Lleva los platos sucios a la cocina.
canonical_example.translation: Take the dirty plates to the kitchen.

canonical_example.text: Mi marido llevará las bolsas de la compra.
canonical_example.translation: My husband will carry the grocery bags.

canonical_example.text: Llevaremos nuestros propios patines a la fiesta.
canonical_example.translation: We'll bring our own skates to the party.

canonical_example.text: Ella siempre lleva sus botas favoritas cuando nieva.
canonical_example.translation: She always wears her favorite boots when it snows.

canonical_example.text: Llevo cuatro horas estudiando y todavía me queda mucho.
canonical_example.translation: I've been studying for four hours and there's still a lot left.

canonical_example.text: Mi marido me lleva dos meses.
canonical_example.translation: My husband is two months older than me.

canonical_example.text: Mi padre está enfermo, por lo que yo estoy llevando la empresa familiar en este momento.
canonical_example.translation: My father is sick, so I'm running the family business at the moment.

canonical_example.text: Se llevó todas sus pertenencias consigo.
canonical_example.translation: He took all of his belongings with him.

canonical_example.text: Las dos hermanas nunca se han llevado bien.
canonical_example.translation: The two sisters have never gotten along well.

canonical_example.text: Te llevo a la estación si quieres.
canonical_example.translation: I can give you a ride to the station if you like.

canonical_example.text: El mayordomo nos llevó a nuestra habitación.
canonical_example.translation: The butler took us to our room.

canonical_example.text: Solo lleva diez minutos rellenar el formulario.
canonical_example.translation: It only takes ten minutes to fill in the form.

canonical_example.text: Me llevaba dos metros de ventaja en la carrera cuando se cayó.
canonical_example.translation: He was ahead of me by two meters in the race when he fell.

canonical_example.text: Sofía lleva todos los asuntos de finanzas en la familia.
canonical_example.translation: Sofía handles all the finances in the family.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quién va a llevar lo del traslado de oficina?
canonical_example.translation: ¿Who's going to deal with the office move?

canonical_example.text: Me enteré de que cerró la fábrica. ¿Cómo lo llevas?
canonical_example.translation: I heard the factory closed down. How are you getting on?

canonical_example.text: La profesora sabe llevar a los alumnos.
canonical_example.translation: The teacher knows how to handle the students.

canonical_example.text: ¿Sabes a dónde lleva este túnel?
canonical_example.translation: Do you know where this tunnel leads to?

canonical_example.text: Lleva comidos cuatro trozos de pizza.
canonical_example.translation: She has already eaten four slices of pizza.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué te llevarás cuando te vayas?
canonical_example.translation: What will you take with you when you go?

canonical_example.text: Se llevan mucho las zapatillas de deporte con trajes ahora.
canonical_example.translation: Wearing sneakers with a suit is really in now.

canonical_example.text: Por lo que se ve, los intrusos no se llevaron nada.
canonical_example.translation: As far as we can see, the intruders didn't take anything.

canonical_example.text: Los ladrones se llevaron los candeleros de plata.
canonical_example.translation: The thieves walked away with the silver candlesticks.

canonical_example.text: Y, además, no tiene ningún interés.
canonical_example.translation: And besides, he is not interested at all.

canonical_example.text: Compró, además, una caja de bombones.
canonical_example.translation: She also bought a box of chocolates.

canonical_example.text: Además, los demandaremos.
canonical_example.translation: Furthermore, we will sue you.

canonical_example.text: Además, no podemos olvidar nuestro compromiso.
canonical_example.translation: Moreover, we cannot forget our commitment.

canonical_example.text: Además de simpática, es bien educada.
canonical_example.translation: She is nice as well as polite.

canonical_example.text: Hubo que ademar las paredes de la mina.
canonical_example.translation: The walls of the mine had to be shored up.

canonical_example.text: No se ha construido el nuevo estadio por falta de fondos.
canonical_example.translation: The new stadium has not been built due to a lack of funds.

canonical_example.text: Cuando murió, nadie notó su falta.
canonical_example.translation: When she died, nobody noticed her absence.

canonical_example.text: Esta falta conlleva una sentencia de diez años como mínimo.
canonical_example.translation: This offense carries a sentence of at least ten years.

canonical_example.text: "¡Falta!", gritó el árbitro.
canonical_example.translation: "Fault!", shouted the umpire.

canonical_example.text: Si falto a clase una vez más, suspenderé la asignatura.
canonical_example.translation: If I miss the class one more time, I will fail the subject.

canonical_example.text: No puedo terminar de montar el armario porque faltan tres tornillos.
canonical_example.translation: I can't finish assembling the closet because there are three screws missing.

canonical_example.text: La falta de maestros preparados es un grave problema para este distrito.
canonical_example.translation: The shortage of trained teachers is a serious problem for this district.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cómo puedes decir que no fue falta? ¡Le entró por detrás!
canonical_example.translation: How can you say it wasn't a foul? He tackled him from behind!

canonical_example.text: ¿Has tenido falta? Puede que estés embarazada.
canonical_example.translation: Have you missed a period? It's possible you're pregnant.

canonical_example.text: ¿Así que has faltado a tu cita con el dentista?
canonical_example.translation: So you didn't turn up at your appointment with the dentist?

canonical_example.text: Nueve personas faltaron a clase.
canonical_example.translation: There were nine people absent from class.

canonical_example.text: Juan ha faltado tres días al trabajo.
canonical_example.translation: Juan has been off work three days.

canonical_example.text: Es buena cocinera, pero le falta experiencia.
canonical_example.translation: She's a good cook, but she lacks experience.

canonical_example.text: A la sopa le faltan 10 minutos.
canonical_example.translation: The soup needs another 10 minutes.

canonical_example.text: Dijo que dejaría de fumar, pero al final faltó a su promesa.
canonical_example.translation: He said he would quit smoking, but in the end he broke his promise.

canonical_example.text: No esperes que te devuelva el dinero porque suele faltar a su palabra.
canonical_example.translation: Don't expect to get your money back from him because he doesn't usually keep his word.

canonical_example.text: No vuelvas a faltarle a tu madre.
canonical_example.translation: Don't you dare to be rude to your mother again.

canonical_example.text: Siento que estoy falto de motivación desde que perdí el trabajo.
canonical_example.translation: I feel I'm lacking in motivation since I lost my job.

canonical_example.text: Ana no está falta de recursos económicos tras su ascenso.
canonical_example.translation: Ana is not short of funds since she was promoted.

canonical_example.text: Luke es una persona totalmente falta de empatía.
canonical_example.translation: Luke is a person with no empathy whatsoever.

canonical_example.text: Tenía una idea general de lo que iba a suceder.
canonical_example.translation: I had a general idea of what was going to happen.

canonical_example.text: El general del ejército tenía miles de soldados bajo su mando.
canonical_example.translation: The army general had thousands of soldiers under his command.

canonical_example.text: El general de los jesuitas decidió dimitir.
canonical_example.translation: The Jesuit general decided to step down.

canonical_example.text: Las apuestas ilegales son una práctica general en este barrio.
canonical_example.translation: Illegal bets are common practice in this neighborhood.

canonical_example.text: El presidente del gobierno anunció nuevos recortes y una subida de impuestos.
canonical_example.translation: The president of the government confirmed new cutbacks and an increase in taxes.

canonical_example.text: El presidente del comité anunció su dimisión en una rueda de prensa.
canonical_example.translation: The chairman of the committee announced his resignation in a press conference.

canonical_example.text: El presidente de la empresa decidió despedir a la mitad de la plantilla.
canonical_example.translation: The president of the company decided to lay off half of the workforce.

canonical_example.text: El presidente británico volvió a ganar las elecciones.
canonical_example.translation: The prime minister of the United Kingdom was reelected.

canonical_example.text: Sam Rayburn era el presidente de la cámara en los años sesenta.
canonical_example.translation: Sam Rayburn was the Speaker of the House in the sixties.

canonical_example.text: La presidenta de la asamblea se opuso a la apertura de una comisión.
canonical_example.translation: The chairwoman of the assembly was against the opening of a commision.

canonical_example.text: Los accionistas nombraron a García presidente de la junta por mayoría absoluta.
canonical_example.translation: The shareholders appointed Garcia as the chairperson of the board with an absolute majority.

canonical_example.text: El presidente del consejo manifestó su desacuerdo con las medidas propuestas.
canonical_example.translation: The chair of the board disagreed with the proposed measures.

canonical_example.text: El presidente de la compañía telefónica optó por subir las tarifas sin consultar con sus asesores.
canonical_example.translation: The president of the phone company opted for raising the fees without consulting his advisors.

canonical_example.translation: Maria Lopez was the chairwoman of this company from 1998 to 2010.

canonical_example.translation: The presiding judge is responsible for leading the court.

canonical_example.text: El presidente derivó el problema al Tribunal Supremo para que tomara una decisión.
canonical_example.translation: The presiding magistrate deferred the issue to the Supreme Court for making a ruling.

canonical_example.text: Al minutar las horas trabajadas, el abogado aplicará las tarifas que especifica el Colegio de Abogados.
canonical_example.translation: When billing for hours worked, the lawyer will apply the rates specified by the Bar Association.

canonical_example.text: Nuestro abogado se encargará de minutar el contrato.
canonical_example.translation: Our lawyer will draft the contract.

canonical_example.text: Es necesario minutar los anuncios para saber cuántos se pueden emitir en cada intermedio.
canonical_example.translation: We need to time the advertisements to know how many of them can be broadcast in each break.

canonical_example.text: Este sistema operativo es peor que el anterior.
canonical_example.translation: This operating system is worse than the previous one.

canonical_example.text: Es el peor libro que he leído últimamente.
canonical_example.translation: It's the worst book I've read lately.

canonical_example.text: Desde que uso esos auriculares, cada día oigo peor.
canonical_example.translation: Since I started using those headphones, I hear worse every day.

canonical_example.text: Vivo en la misma calle que mis padres.
canonical_example.translation: I live on the same street as my parents.

canonical_example.text: Tengan cuidado al cruzar la calle.
canonical_example.translation: Be careful when crossing the road.

canonical_example.text: No he salido a la calle en tres días.
canonical_example.translation: I haven't been outside for three days.

canonical_example.text: Creo que mi bola está en la calle.
canonical_example.translation: I think my ball is on the fairway.

canonical_example.text: La nadadora de la calle tres es la campeona.
canonical_example.translation: The swimmer in lane three is the winner.

canonical_example.text: Mejor callar y esperar que no se repita.
canonical_example.translation: We'd better keep quiet and hope it doesn't happen again.

canonical_example.text: Calla y déjame pensar.
canonical_example.translation: Be quiet and let me think.
